final: WITH g AS (SELECT p.ID AS ID, p.SEX AS SEX, AVG(l.PT) AS pt, AVG(l.IGA - l.IGM) AS d FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), o AS (SELECT AVG(d) AS od FROM g), pr AS (SELECT g.SEX AS SEX, g.pt AS pt, g.d AS d, g.d / o.od AS ratio FROM g JOIN o ON o.od IS NOT NULL) SELECT SEX, AVG(pt), AVG(d), AVG(ratio) FROM pr GROUP BY SEX
